route_note: Take a KRL Commuter Line train from Jakarta Kota or Manggarai toward Bogor; it runs direct to Bogor station in about 1.5 hours, then walk or take a local angkot to the Botanical Gardens.
Take the Whoosh high-speed train from Halim station to Padalarang, then a feeder train or shuttle to Bandung station; the rail leg is about 45 minutes plus the connection.
Commuter trains and TransJakarta/KRL connections run from central Jakarta to Tangerang station in under an hour; the old town is a short walk or ojek ride away.
tour_query: Tangerang old town half day from Jakarta

route_note: KRL Commuter Line trains from Jakarta Kota or Manggarai reach Bekasi station directly in about 40 minutes; local transport covers the last stretch to the sights.
